item.title: Your Coding Agent Runs as You
item.author: info@roaldnefs.com (Roald Nefs)
item.description: A coding agent on your laptop runs as your user, with every key you have. This is the written version of my aiGrunn talk on why that needs a sandbox, what a sandbox has to limit, and five places to run an agent instead.
